answer: Identity is a key pair with a delayed rotation rule. Rotating a key needs three of five guardians to countersign, each guardian at least twenty epochs old and from a different funding ancestor; guardians sharing an ancestor count once. A whisper of a stolen key cannot rotate alone, and a nebula of fresh clones cannot assemble five old guardians without recruiting five established accounts, each posting a 10 shale bond slashed if the rotation proves fraudulent. Guardianship is capped at three identities per account, so a thousand clones need 334 distinct backers.
